titles.title: Northeast Lobsterman Protection Act of 2026
Northeast Lobsterman Protection Act of 2026
To amend the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2023 to extend the time period for which certain regulations concerning the North Atlantic right whale are effective.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Natural Resources.
